g.text: FINAL YEAR PROJECT (FYP) — MULTI-AGENT MARKET RESEARCH PLATFORM (MARP)
MASTER RELATIONAL SCHEMA (ERD) • 3 DISTINCT MARKED CIRCLES / STUDENT WORK BREAKDOWN MATRIX
User credentials, access control & profile records
5 Enterprise System Roles for RBAC authorization
User to Role assignment junction table
Android field hardware devices, IMEI & security status
Forensic ledger of system activity and audit trail
• Tenant Workspace Isolation: Zero data leakage across companies via FK company_id.
• 5 Enterprise System Roles: Admin, Research Manager, Analyst, Field Staff, Reviewer.
• Token Authentication: BCrypt password hashing & signed PyJWT bearer tokens.
• Mobile Device Integrity: IMEI tracking, remote authorization & instant revocation.
• Forensic Security Audit: Actor, action, client IP, timestamp & JSON metadata.
Sealed immutable JSON snapshots & version changelog
Single choice, multiple choice & dropdown items
Dynamic conditional logic engine (Show / Hide / Skip)
MUDASIR ALI (2312465) — TECHNICAL HIGHLIGHTS & LOGIC ENGINE
• 10 Visual Question Formats: Short/Long Text, Radio, Multiple Choice, Dropdown, Rating 1-5, Photo Upload, GPS Coordinates, DateTime.
• Deterministic Conditional Branching: Evaluates answers in real time to show, hide, or mandate follow-up questions dynamically.
• Native Multilingual Urdu Support (RTL): Right-to-Left Nastaliq typography rendering for field surveys across Pakistan.
• Immutable Version Snapshots: Publishing freezes a JSON schema snapshot to guarantee historical research validity.
• Respondent Eligibility & SMS OTP: Configurable demographic targeting constraints and cellular SMS verification provider.
Competitor brand intelligence & market share entities
Deploy questionnaires to active research campaigns
Field photos, GPS coordinates & audit verification
ABDULLAH ZAFAR KHAN (2312467) — GEOGRAPHICAL ENGINE & ASSETS
• 5-Tier Hierarchical Pakistan Geographical Tree: Country → Province → City → Area → Site with recursive parent_id.
• Out-of-Home Billboard & Media Registry: Dimensions (e.g. 60x20 ft), illumination (Frontlit/Backlit/SMD), and orientation.
• Competitor Market Intelligence: Tracks competitor brand footprints, share of voice, and comparative location analytics.
• Field Workforce Scheduling & Evidence Review: Dispatches field surveyors with photo verification & GPS audit matching.
